approval_basis: Literal rail, three wing pairs, central 50 mm wall, 16/32 mm L contact feet, paired carrier supports and central access match saved geometry without calling source shape generators.
All 36 independent new native-control cases and preserved old native-control cases pass; saved axis origins, parentage, offsets, rotations and control scope were retained in raw audit.
All four native CAD artifacts have consistent manufacturing-part process/material metadata (34 repeated manufacturing-object instances across files).

All old production and regression fixture geometries, placements, parentage, expressions, schema and design metadata agree. Their only saved-property deltas are generated Uid, Visibility and SourceFingerprint.
Candidate source and CAD files remained unchanged throughout read-only review.
reviewed_design_deltas: Old T rail and downward pressure clamps replaced by 300 mm segmented upright side-slot rail and exposed M2 x 8 side bolt/nut joints. Seven wing pairs become three; no M3 island design retained.
Equipment 16 mm L feet and propulsion 32 mm offset L foot replace old shoes; rail coupon and fit coupon intentionally replaced. No retained native parent/type changes.
Equipment plate top rises 15.4 to 16 mm; two short supports preserve centre-hole access. Optical post shortens 0.6 mm to retain global pitch height 35 mm.

Default module X: battery 90 to 100, propulsion 0 to -5, FC -54 to -60, accessory remains -140. Old +/-0.1 mm clamp Y offsets become zero. Propulsion bolt remains local offset +12.5 mm; 150 mm axis span and 50 mm axis height are retained.
Derived wiring and equipment envelopes follow the carrier height and module placement. Gears, shafts, bearings, horn interfaces, motor carriers and their local motion geometry remain unchanged.

Four old Clamp screw/nut name pairs become Mount screw/nut pairs. AssemblySettings bidirectional clamp selector and corresponding conditional expressions removed. Continuous within-slot RailPositionX controls, read-only contact length/offset metadata and tilt/optical controls reviewed.

Print labels, manufacturing metadata, procurement envelopes, physical qualification limits and rail contracts are updated consistently. Remaining geometry/registry/property/expression changes were reviewed in raw transition report.

current_source_validator_on_old_fixture.error: A registered module has no continuous rail attachment control

non_equivalent_legacy_validator.explanation: Expected schema mismatch: current source requires new side-slot attachment controls. This raw failure is retained, not reclassified as success. Separate literal old/native control audit passes and is the old-behavior evidence.

limits: Approval concerns intentional CAD regression transition, not print release, structural qualification, creep, adhesive sufficiency, curved-envelope fit, physical fastener tolerances or flight readiness.

Fine adjustment is limited to each supported wall/slot interval; moving between intervals requires disengaging the bolt and lifting. Module collisions and cable reach constrain actual populated positions further.
Parent still must promote exact candidate, update only source fixture-hash pointer, rebuild production, compare geometry/parents/native controls/design metadata and run complete regression.
Regenerated Uid, presentation and SourceFingerprint are generation-state deltas to classify explicitly; do not claim byte-identical production CAD.
